title: Rowlatt Satyagraha And Jallianwala Bagh Massacre April 13 1919
definition: The Rowlatt Satyagraha was the first mass-based political movement led by Gandhi against the repressive Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act (1919), which culminated in the brutal Jallianwala Bagh massacre, marking a turning point in the Indian freedom struggle.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is central to understanding the transition from moderate to mass-based nationalism, the radicalization of the Indian youth, and the subsequent launch of the Non-Cooperation Movement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Rowlatt Satyagraha And Jallianwala Bagh Massacre April 13 1919.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Impact of WWI on Indian Economy
